scope: 1996 classic English base game pp.1–12; no expansions or optional short game

questions.question: How are the King and home regions assigned, and where do each player’s initial ten Caballeros go?
Who begins playing power cards in the first and later rounds, in what seating direction do others play, and may a played value be matched?
What determines turn order and court recruitment, and when is recruitment done relative to choosing an action card?
If a power card allows recruitment but your provinces lack enough, what alternative is allowed, and which protected locations cannot supply it?
Where may ordinary action-card deployment go, may it be split, and must the full printed allowance be used?
May special action and ordinary deployment be done in either order, may either be interleaved with the other, and may the special action be declined?
What happens to selected and unselected face-up action cards after turns and rounds, and what is exceptional about the King card?
What changes are forbidden in the King’s region, may it still be scored, and what kind of action changes its protected status?
When putting Caballeros into the Castillo, what must be announced, how does King location affect entry, and when may they leave?
List the timing and ordered stages of general scoring, including when destinations are chosen relative to revealing the Castillo.
At general scoring, may one player split Castillo Caballeros between regions, choose the King’s region, or keep them in the Castillo; what happens if the King’s region was chosen?
In a five-player scoring of 5/3/1, three players have four Caballeros each and another has three. What do these four players score, and do Grandes count?
In a five-player region worth 6/4/2 with counts 4,3,2,2, what does each score?
Which scoreboard ranks pay in two-player and three-player games, and what happens to a two-player tie for first?
When are the King’s and home bonuses awarded, how much is each, and what happens on a tied majority?
Does specially scoring the Castillo empty it or redistribute its Caballeros? Describe what happens.
Can a mobile scoreboard be put at the Castillo, moved into/out of King’s region, stacked on the other, or rotated to change its values?
What are the legal source/destination restrictions on moving your Grande, may other Grandes already be there, and what changes afterward?
Which power card may the recovery action return, can it be the card used this turn, and must the choice be revealed?
When does the standard game end, and how is the winner determined?
How are action stacks prepared, how many cards are revealed at the start of each round, and where does the standard round marker start?
After you play a power card, is it returned to hand for later rounds, and how are played cards displayed?
If you use the King card’s special action before deploying, which King position controls deployment, and where may the King be placed?
How is a Veto card retained, what can it prevent, and can it stop the ordinary deployment part of another action card?
With Veto held, must other players announce special actions, when should you object, and what happens if it is partly or fully completed?
When is Veto discarded after use, and when does an unused Veto expire?
Who is affected by the all-court Decay of Authority card and where do those Caballeros go, including a player with an empty court?
For Decay of Authority requiring three from each fellow player’s court, what happens if a fellow player has two and you have five?
For The King returns!, what does the detailed execution paragraph require about participants, amount, sources and order, and how does its heading differ?
On the action sending one Caballero from each player from any region back to provinces, who chooses the pieces, does the acting player lose one, and what sources are excluded?
For the secret removal of two own Caballeros from a region, how do affected fellow players choose and reveal, and what region must a player with a legal region containing at least two choose?
For secret removal of two, if a fellow player has single own Caballeros in legal regions but never more than one in any region, what selection and removal is required?
For fellow players secretly returning all their own Caballeros from one region, what must the chosen region contain, how is it selected, and what if a player has no Caballeros in any region?
For the special action choosing any one location to score, may you choose the King’s region or Castillo, do ordinary scoring rules apply, and are Castillo pieces redistributed?

For scoring all 4-value regions, name the printed group and explain what value determines eligibility when mobile scoreboards are present. Specifically, Galicia has8/4/0 and Granada4/0/0: which qualifies, and do bonuses apply?
Which printed regions are the 5-value group and the 6-and-7-value group, how do mobile scoreboards affect these groups, and is the Castillo included in all-5 scoring?
When the first-position-only scoring card is used, what do tied leaders and lower ranks score, and is the Castillo scored?
For the most-Caballeros-region scoring card, what if two board regions tie for the most total Caballeros and the Castillo contains more than either?
For the least-Caballeros-region scoring card, how are empty regions, ties for least and the Castillo treated?
For the 4-stack Movement card, whose pieces leave the chosen region, how are destinations selected, and what happens to a player choosing the King’s region or the region being vacated?
How far may Royal Adviser move the King, compared with the King card?
What does The Court special action add, from where to where, and how is this separate from a 4-stack card’s normal deployment?
On the action where each player secretly chooses a region to score, how are choices made/revealed and how are duplicate and unique selections resolved?
For Intrigue moving all your own Caballeros from one region, can you split them and leave some in the original region, and what origin/destination restrictions apply?
With Intrigue adding two more Caballeros from court, how many may be added including normal deployment, and how do the two destination allowances differ?
For the Intrigue choice card offering two additional court Caballeros OR all own Caballeros from one region, may you execute both special alternatives, and what normal deployment remains?
For Intrigue moving up to five Caballeros from any one region, may they have different owners or come from multiple origin regions, and where can they go?
For Intrigue moving any three foreign Caballeros, may you choose fewer or use multiple origins, can your own pieces be included, and what destinations are legal?
For the Intrigue cards moving any three or any four Caballeros on the board, what is the ownership and origin flexibility, each maximum, and destination restriction?

For Intrigue moving two of yours and two foreign Caballeros, what are the separate ownership allowances, may multiple origin regions be used, and what locations are forbidden as sources or allowed as destinations?
For Intrigue moving any four of your own Caballeros, what maximum/ownership and origin/destination restrictions apply?
